_meta.note: Source catalog for vaultrobbers-mint/public/index.html. Keys grouped by UI area. Placeholders use {name} syntax. English is the base/fallback; it must render pixel-identical to the hard-coded source. Crypto proper nouns (ROBINVAULT, Vault Robbers, Vault Standoff, OpenSea, Robinhood Chain, NFT) are left untranslated across catalogs.

v1.title: Robbing the Vault, V1 Classic
v1.body: The original push-your-luck heist that started it all. Thousands of runs, one cracked core. Immortalized on-chain and free to play forever, no wallet needed.
v2.title: Robbing the Vault, V2
v2.body: The vault reborn: bigger, tougher, and smarter. Deeper chambers, real skill games, and the first shape of the Vault Robbers crew. Immortalized on-chain and free to play forever.
v3.title: Vault Standoff, V3
v3.body: The final heist, now a free solo run against the AI crew. Pick a door, outlast the crowd, and be the last robber standing. Immortalized on-chain and free to play forever, no wallet needed.

rvlt.title: ROBINVAULT
rvlt.intro: The token that ran the heist. The vault is retired and the crew lives on, but the chain keeps score. Live numbers below.
rvlt.howBody: RobinVault started as a push-your-luck heist on Robinhood Chain: crack the vault, burn ROBINVAULT, chase the pot. Two seasons, thousands of runs, nearly half the supply burned, now playable free forever. The crew puts on masks next: mint a Vault Robber and carry it into what comes.
rvlt.note: Circulating {circulating} ROBINVAULT. Total burned and all-time volume are final; the token still trades on Robinhood Chain.
story.title: The story so far
story.intro: How a push-your-luck heist on Robinhood Chain became the Vault Robbers, told chapter by chapter, straight from the threads.
lore.0.sum: Where it all began. The pitch: a push-your-luck heist built on Robinhood Chain, where every crack of the vault burns ROBINVAULT and every step deeper raises the stakes. This is the thread that set the whole thing in motion.
lore.1.sum: The vault opens and the first crews step inside. Early robbers test the mechanics and learn how far their nerve will carry them. The first legends, and the first losses, get written.
lore.2.sum: The stakes climb. Chambers get deeper, the pot swells, and the community starts to master the risk and reward of pushing one more door. Momentum builds as bigger runs start landing.
lore.3.sum: A step back to tell the origin story. How the idea formed, why Robinhood Chain, and what the vault is really about. Context for everyone arriving mid-heist.
lore.4.sum: The legend grows. The crew pushes deeper than ever, the biggest runs get their moment, and the world of the vault fills out. The story crests toward its first season finale.
lore.5.sum: Season one, in the books. A look back at everything the crew pulled off: the runs, the burns, the ETH robbed, and the players who made it happen. V1 becomes history, immortalized on-chain.
lore.6.sum: The vault reborn: bigger, tougher, and smarter. New chambers, new skills, and the first real shape of the Vault Robbers crew. This is where the game levels up and points toward what comes next.
lore.7.sum: The crew steps into the light. The latest dispatch on where the Vault Robbers are headed next.
